Exp - Get CalcExpress Error as Error Cluster.vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Development

Use this VI to retrieve CalcExpress error as the standard LabVIEW error cluster. If it is allowed, the VI returns error information stored in the Error Protocol associated with the CalcExpress instance to which InstanceRef refers.

Click the parameters for more information

 

InstanceRef is the reference to the CalcExpress instance that evaluates a CalcExpress expression.
Get CE Error (T). If it is TRUE (by default), the VI calls CalcExpress Engine to retrieve error information. If there is an error occured prior this VI executes, information on the error is returned in error out. Most FuncVI support VIs use boolean <error in> and <error out>. You might connect Get CE Error to a boolean <error out> indicator of these VIs for data flow.
error in is the standard LabVIEW error cluster. The VI executes normally only if error in does not indicate any error, otherwise the VI merely passes the error in value to error out.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
dup Get CE Error returns the same value as Get CE Error control.
error out is the standard LabVIEW error cluster. If error in indicated an error, the error out contains the same information. Otherwise, the VI returns information on CalcExpress error if any occurred prior this VI executes.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
